title: Senior Operations Associate
description:
Senior Operations Associate

Brainware University is looking for a highly analytical, technology-oriented and research-

driven professional to strengthen the operational and strategic capabilities of the Office of the Registrar.

The incumbent will be responsible for leveraging Data Science, Data Analytics, Artificial

Intelligence (AI), automation and market research to improve institutional operations,

develop technology-enabled administrative systems and support data-driven decision-making.

The role requires a professional who can independently identify operational challenges,

conceptualise solutions, develop AI-powered tools and systems, conduct comprehensive

research and coordinate effectively with different academic and administrative stakeholders.

**About Us:**

Brainware University is a premier institution dedicated to providing world-class education and fostering academic excellence. Our commitment to innovation, research, and holistic development sets us apart as a leader in higher education. Join us in shaping the future of tomorrow's leaders.

**Key responsibilities:**

A. Data Science & Institutional Data Analytics

B. Artificial Intelligence & Technology Development

C. Advanced Excel & Business Intelligence

D. Market Research & Strategic Research

E. Administrative Communication & Institutional Coordination

F. Systems Development & Process Automation

**Qualifications and experience:**

1. Master degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information

Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Management or a closely

related discipline.

2. Candidates with an MBA complemented by strong technical expertise in Data

Science, AI and analytics may also be considered.

3. Relevant certifications in Data Science, AI, Business Intelligence or software

development will be an added advantage.

4.Min 5-6 years of relevant professional experience in Data Analytics, Business

Intelligence, Technology, AI-driven operations, Research or Strategic Operations.

5.Experience in developing analytical systems, automated workflows and technology-

enabled business solutions.

6.Demonstrated experience in independent research, data interpretation and

management reporting.

7.Experience in higher education or large institutional environments will be an added

advantage.

**Technical Skills:**

1. Advanced Microsoft Excel.

2. Data Science and Statistical Analysis.

3. Python and/or R for data analysis.

4. SQL and database management.

5. Power BI, Tableau or equivalent dashboard platforms.

6. Generative AI platforms and AI-assisted development tools.

7. AI-based application development and workflow automation.

8. Market research methodologies and data visualization.

9. Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Word.

**What we offer:**

* A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
* The chance to contribute to a thriving academic community.
